## Artifact version and example

Which commit, fixture, or worksheet section did you examine?

## Observation

What was unclear or incorrect? Describe a fictional or public example. Do not include private records, credentials, personal data, or confidential company information.

## Proposed correction

What would make the boundary clearer? Include a relevant primary source if one supports the correction.

## Scope of your review

What did you inspect, and what did you leave untested? A review does not imply endorsement or production validation.

## Relationship disclosure

If relevant, describe your relationship to the author or project. Do not include private contact details. Leave your name and affiliation out unless you want them public in this issue.
